sources.entry: CaptuocrToy - Tool to capture screenshot and recognize text by online ocr apis.

summary.one_liner: CaptuocrToy is a macOS tool, listed as a graphics app, that captures a screenshot and recognizes text in it using online OCR APIs (per the listing description); the README itself was not available.
summary.what_it_does: The README could not be retrieved, so this summary relies on the repository name and the listing description only. According to that listing, the app captures a screenshot and sends it to online OCR APIs to recognize text. Beyond that, the README gives no details on the capture workflow, supported OCR providers, settings, or output format. The repository is listed under the Graphics category of an open-source macOS apps list.
use_cases: copying text from images on macOS
notable: Captures a screenshot and recognizes text from it
Uses online OCR APIs, per the listing description
caveats: README not available, so setup, usage and supported features are unverified
Relies on online OCR APIs, so recognition likely needs network access and may involve a third-party service
